title: 01 UniLab Runtime Atlas
subtitle: 按正式运行顺序阅读 CLI 配置 环境 物理 采集 学习 持久化与回放 owner

systems.title: Entry And Configuration
systems.summary: 把用户选择收敛为一个合法 task algorithm backend runtime

modules.title: CLI Route
modules.summary: 把 train eval demo 与显式 algo task sim 选择路由到正式脚本
modules.owns: 用户入口 路由参数校验 Python runtime 与训练脚本选择
modules.mustNot: 不解释 reward observation backend 私有能力或算法超参数

files.role: 统一 CLI 路由 owner

mainRoute: B1 cli.py parser: terminal argv -> validated CLI request
B2 build_route(): validated request -> script and config group
B3 build_command(): route plus explicit flags -> subprocess command
review: 检查 algo task sim 只能由显式 flag 决定
确认目标脚本和 owner YAML 存在
modules.gap: 不同算法仍有多个脚本入口 但共享同一 CLI route contract

modules.title: Hydra Run Assembly
modules.summary: 组合算法根配置 task owner YAML device seed logger 与运行模式
modules.owns: Hydra compose task backend owner 训练装配与 env override 构造
modules.mustNot: scripts 不长期拥有 task reward 或 backend-specific 业务规则

files.role: task cfg 到 env cfg adapter

mainRoute: B1 Hydra compose: root config plus task choice -> resolved cfg
B2 owner guards: resolved cfg -> validated task backend algorithm identity
B3 BackendAdapter: validated cfg -> environment configuration override
B4 script main(): cfg plus mode -> train or playback assembly
review: backend 切换必须来自 task backend YAML
算法超参数直接来自 compose 后 cfg
modules.gap: 跨算法脚本形态不同 需要依靠共同 contract 而不是单一 runner

systems.title: Environment And Physics
systems.summary: 从 registry 构造任务并通过 SimBackend 推进统一物理状态

modules.title: Registry Construction
modules.summary: 用 task name backend 与 EnvCfg override 构造已注册环境
modules.owns: 环境注册 backend 支持矩阵 dataclass override 与实例构造
modules.mustNot: 算法和脚本不能直接 import task class 绕开 registry
mainRoute: B1 registry lookup: task plus backend -> EnvMeta and env class
B2 apply_cfg_overrides(): owner overrides -> validated EnvCfg
B3 registry.make(): validated config plus num_envs -> concrete ABEnv
review: 未知 task backend 必须 fail closed
override 未知字段必须拒绝
modules.gap: 环境注册依赖 import side effects 需要入口显式完成注册

modules.title: SimBackend
modules.summary: 把 MuJoCo 与 Motrix 状态推进归一为一个 backend contract
modules.owns: 物理 state step model query control range DR capability 与 playback plan
modules.mustNot: env 以上层不能调用 MuJoCo 或 Motrix 子类私有方法
mainRoute: B1 env control: action-derived ctrl -> backend step request
B2 backend adapter: ctrl plus nsteps -> backend-native physics advance
B3 state refresh: native result -> normalized state and timing evidence
review: 新增能力先进入 SimBackend 抽象
step 热路径不得解析 asset metadata
modules.gap: 部分 playback 能力按 backend capability 合法不同

modules.title: Task Environment
modules.summary: 拥有 observation reward command action done reset 与 task semantics
modules.owns: NpEnv lifecycle task state observation groups reward terms 与 autoreset
modules.mustNot: backend 不拥有 reward 与 policy observation scripts 不改写 env lifecycle
mainRoute: B1 apply_action(): policy action plus state -> backend control
B2 SimBackend.step(): backend control -> advanced physics
B3 update_state(): physics state -> obs reward termination info
B4 autoreset: done mask -> reset state plus final observation contract
review: obs_groups_spec 与 learner dim 一致
modules.gap: 不同任务语义很多 但必须共享 NpEnv lifecycle

systems.title: Collection And Learning
systems.summary: 把环境 transition 安全传给 learner 并同步新策略权重

modules.title: Runner And Collector
modules.summary: 管理同步或异步 rollout collector IPC replay 与异常生命周期
modules.owns: collector process shared resources replay transport weight sync 与 cleanup
modules.mustNot: 传输层不能改变 observation reward done 或 action 语义

files.role: 异步 runner 生命周期
DAgger exact resource cache and reset lifecycle
DAgger production G1 worker and HP-4a2a request observation owner
APPO payload and collector specialization hooks
AMP typed payload and learner specialization

mainRoute: B1 runner setup: env spec plus cfg -> collector learner shared resources
B2 collector rollout: policy weights plus env -> transition batches
B3 IPC transport: transition batches -> learner replay or rollout storage
B4 lifecycle guard: stop or exception -> traceback propagation and cleanup
review: collector 异常必须回传完整 traceback
shared memory 预算与 cleanup 必须可证明
tests: S2/S3 formal AMP spawn resume playback and isolation
S1 typed IPC layout and dtype
S2 DAgger persistent lifecycle and barrier
S1/S2/S3 HP-4a2d workflow learner cleanup persistence
modules.gap: DAgger runtime 已完成接入, E61/E65/E67 证明 NO_STABLE_SPEEDUP, HP-6/E86 production gate PASS; promotion deferred 且默认 legacy; 同步 PPO 与异步 off-policy storage 形态仍不同

modules.title: Policy Learner
modules.summary: 在 accelerator 上消费 rollout 或 replay 并更新 policy parameters
modules.owns: network optimizer loss normalization mixed precision compile 与 update schedule
modules.mustNot: learner 不直接访问 backend state 或重新定义 env observation contract

files.role: distillation invocation-local balanced staging and replay-budget owner

mainRoute: B1 distillation staging or readiness guard: loaded dataset -> one immutable label-pool cache -> equivalent valid training batch
B2 model forward: training batch -> policy value and target tensors
B3 loss and optimizer: tensors plus cfg -> updated parameters
B4 weight publication: updated parameters -> collector or next rollout policy
review: shape normalization checkpoint contract 与 env spec 一致
更新频率不能绕过 runner lifecycle
tests: S1/S2 frozen-D AMP reward V-trace ordering and checkpoint
S1 AMP forward-only manifest and 195-D source parity
modules.gap: HP-7c cache owner/S1/S2 and E95 production-path CUDA staging sentinel pass; bounded persistent end-to-end evidence pending; 各算法 update 公式不同但 runtime ownership 相同

systems.title: Run Identity And Playback
systems.summary: 把训练结果保存为可追踪 run 并在兼容 backend 中回放

modules.title: Run Identity And Checkpoint
modules.summary: 保存 run config contract snapshot metrics checkpoint 与结束摘要
modules.owns: log dir run identity experiment metadata checkpoint resolution 与 summary
modules.mustNot: 不能按文件大小猜 checkpoint 语义或静默加载另一个 run

files.role: distillation performance schema, full request/workflow/cleanup identity, and atomic run artifact
no-training formal time-sorted output identity, lineage command freeze and oracle owner

mainRoute: B1 tracker start: resolved cfg plus identity -> run_config and contract snapshot
B2 checkpoint save: learner state plus counters -> named model artifact
B3 tracker finish: metrics plus wall time -> run summary and logger close
review: checkpoint 路径与 run_config 必须成对核对
跨 backend 需要读取 contract snapshot
tests: S1/S2/S3 HP-4a2d workflow learner cleanup persistence
modules.gap: request/workflow/learner/cleanup 与 reset/resource timing 已由 E61/E65/E67 runtime-confirmed, 但 NO_STABLE_SPEEDUP; HP-6/E86 production gate PASS, promotion deferred; 旧 run 无 snapshot 时只能 warning fallback

modules.title: Playback And Sim2Sim
modules.summary: 校验策略 I O contract 后创建交互或录制回放 session
modules.owns: checkpoint load dim guard sim2sim compatibility playback plan 与 viewer lifecycle
modules.mustNot: 不能让目标 backend 差异静默改变策略 observation action 或网络结构
mainRoute: B1 resolve checkpoint: launch request plus run identity -> exact artifact
B2 sim2sim guard: source snapshot plus target cfg -> compatible playback cfg
B3 create session: policy plus env plus backend plan -> playback session
B4 session step: command plus observation -> action and rendered next state
review: DENYLIST 差异默认 fail closed
viewer 通过 backend playback capability 而非私有探测选择
modules.gap: 真实 viewer 与物理质量仍需 task-specific live gate
